styleAnswer.evidence: The candidate has 20 visible tones per 16x16 tile, matching the well (20) and above the cheese stall (17) and hedge (9). Its near-flat coverage is 6%, below the stall's 13%, so there are no large flat fills. The 0% near-neutral share of dark edge pixels means the outline is tinted. By eye it is a dark brown beside the wood, not a black sticker line. The frame has a lit top edge, mid wood and dark shelf undersides, about 4 steps. The helmets show several metal tones with highlights and small red details, so the shelf is not a flat body. It is a little less ramped than the references' 5-6 steps, and the wood grain is modest. Overall it is comparable to the stall and well and would sit next to them without looking thinner or flatter.
